acquisition_method.evidence: We utilized data-independent acquisition (DIA) to get comprehensive information on phosphorylation inside LPS-stimulated TLR4 signaling pathways in macrophages.

Although phosphoproteins in TLR4 signaling pathways have been extensively investigated by mass spectrometry using data-dependent acquisition (DDA), the phosphoproteins that initiate TLR4 signaling cascades remain poorly understood due to technical limitations.
